reviewer: Codex primary agent, AI-assisted open-label multilingual manual reading
scope: Existing output review only; no new tests or automated validation.
standard: Minor defects preserving overall meaning are warnings; foreign copying, clear causal/agency reversal and current-only scope violation are blockers. Implicit subjects remain uncertain.

cases.source: My sister left a blue jar beside the gate.
cases.output: My sister left a blue jar beside the gate.
cases.reviewer_expectation: Sister (female sibling), left/placed a blue jar, beside gate; do not turn left into kept.
cases.label: acceptable
cases.note: Same-language control: meaning retained; excluded from foreign denominator.

cases.source: She did not break it; I did.
cases.output: She didn’t break it; I did.
cases.reviewer_expectation: She=sister, it=jar from previous line; sister did NOT break it, speaker DID. Pronoun omission acceptable if roles/polarity preserved.
cases.label: acceptable
cases.note: Same-language control: meaning retained; excluded from foreign denominator.

cases.source: I never said you were the one who left.
cases.output: I never said you were the one who left.
cases.reviewer_expectation: Speaker denies having said YOU were the departing person. Do not assert nobody left or speaker left.
cases.label: acceptable
cases.note: Same-language control: meaning retained; excluded from foreign denominator.

cases.source: Not because I stopped loving you, but because I could not make you stay.
cases.output: Not because I stopped loving you, but because I couldn’t make you stay.
cases.reviewer_expectation: Not ceased love; unable to make addressee stay; preserve contrast/negation.
cases.label: acceptable
cases.note: Same-language control: meaning retained; excluded from foreign denominator.

cases.source: 她把那封没寄出的信交给了我。
cases.output: She handed me the unsent letter.
cases.reviewer_expectation: She handed speaker that unsent letter; do not say it was sent or handed by speaker.
cases.label: acceptable
cases.note: Manual reading found negation, roles, clauses and requested repetition retained. Light/fire ambiguity is accepted without inventing certainty.

cases.source: 我没烧掉它，只把它藏在旧外套里。
cases.output: I didn’t burn it; I just hid it in my old jacket.
cases.reviewer_expectation: Speaker did NOT burn it=letter, only hid it in an old coat; both actions and old preserved.
cases.label: warning
cases.note: my old jacket specifies ownership absent from the standalone source. Context makes it plausible, not explicit.

cases.source: 不是你忘了我，是我不敢叫住你。

cases.reviewer_expectation: NOT you forgot me; I did not dare call out/stop you. Roles and polarity critical.
cases.label: acceptable
cases.note: Manual reading found negation, roles, clauses and requested repetition retained. Light/fire ambiguity is accepted without inventing certainty.

cases.source: 내 친구는 불을 끄지 않았어, 바람이 껐어.

cases.label: blocker
cases.note: the wind also stopped loses wind as extinguishing agent; a new defect compared with the plain prompt.

cases.source: 그가 떠나서 슬픈 게 아니라, 작별 인사도 못 해서 슬퍼.
cases.output: It’s not that he left and I’m sad, but I’m sad because I couldn’t say goodbye to him.
cases.reviewer_expectation: Sad NOT because he left, but because could not even say goodbye. Omitted goodbye subject remains ambiguous; do not score invented subject as certainty.
cases.label: uncertain
cases.note: Causal contrast retained; omitted Korean goodbye subject/recipient become I/him, plausible but not uniquely established.

cases.source: 돌아와, 돌아와, 돌아와, 내가 기다린 건 어제가 아니라 오늘이야.

cases.source: I won't say goodbye，直到你说 괜찮아。
cases.output: I won’t say goodbye until you say 괜찮아.
cases.reviewer_expectation: I will NOT say goodbye UNTIL you say it is okay; translate EN/ZH/KO fragments, preserve won't/until.
cases.label: blocker
cases.note: Korean 괜찮아 remains untranslated in the English target.

cases.source: Stay with me，别松开我的手；stay with me，别松开我的手；stay with me，哪怕夜再长、路再远、风再冷，我也不会把你一个人留在雨里。
